title: Time source priority integration test
description: Integration test for time source priority across multiple boards. Submit samples from different source classes, verify highest-priority wins.
close_reason: Already fixed: Comprehensive time source priority integration tests exist in /lichen/tests/hal/src/main.c. Tests include: test_time_provider_precedence_stale_and_gnss_location_separation, test_time_provider_build_epoch_floor_and_diagnostics, and test_time_provider_provision_epoch_floor_and_recovery. These tests submit samples from different source classes (MANUAL_STATIC, LOCAL_CLIENT, NETWORK, GNSS, INTERNAL_RTC), verify priority ordering (manual > network > gnss), verify lower-trust rejection with -EALREADY, and verify stale-sample fallback. Tests run on multiple platforms (native_sim, native_sim/native/64, qemu_x86) via testcase.yaml.
